invocation_id.description: Client-generated ULID; the idempotency key for launching (D11).

path.description: Canonical command path, aliases resolved (e.g. ["do"] for "discover").

argv.description: Tokens after the path, exactly as given, in order.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory the invocation was requested from.

stdin_text.description: Optional attended text supplied through the worker input collector; never argv.
